part3_pyqt module

PyQt5 graphical interface for the School Management System.

Provides forms to add, update and delete students, instructors and courses, tables listing all records with live search, and a File menu for JSON, CSV and database backup operations.

class part3_pyqt.SchoolWindow(db_path='school.db')[source]
